# engram-anki-package fixtures

`golden-v11-filtered-media.apkg` is a deterministic APKG fixture generated by
the ignored `regenerate_checked_in_golden_v11_apkg_fixture` test. It contains a
V11 SQLite collection with a filtered deck, original deck/due metadata, a media
sound reference, and an image reference.

Regenerate it with:

```powershell
cargo test -p engram-anki-package regenerate_checked_in_golden_v11_apkg_fixture -- --ignored --exact
```
